parameters.name: CloudCode
parameters.description: The code of the multicloud environment.

parameters.name: LogCodes
parameters.description: The list of log codes. The value must be a JSON array.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the Data Management center of Threat Analysis is located. Select the region based on the region where your assets are located. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: Your assets are in the Chinese mainland or China (Hong Kong).

- ap-southeast-1: Your assets are outside China.

parameters.name: RoleFor
parameters.description: The user ID of the member. This parameter allows an administrator to switch to the perspective of a member account.

parameters.name: RoleType
parameters.description:
The view type.

- 0: The view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

- 1: The view of all accounts that belong to the enterprise.
